question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.
solution: The correct answer is **"genres."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Genres"** refers to different categories or types of art, literature, music, or film. (साहित्‍य, कला, फ़िल्‍म या संगीत का विशेष प्रकार जिसकी पहचान के विशिष्‍ट लक्षण होते हैं; रूप विधा) • **Example**: *What **genres**__ do the book fall into - comedy or tragedy?* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank in the given sentence. • Grammatically, **"genres"** is a plural noun. • The correct answer is Option 3. • Correct passage: I hope you will find this series __helpful__ in developing language skills of the learners through diverse reading __**genres**__ such as fairy tales, fables, classics, adventure, biography, drama and so on. The prose pieces ______ (3) ______ for intensive language study while the poems ______ (4) ______ enable children to develop an ear for ______ (5) ______ and rhythm. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Habits" **are regular patterns of behavior, and are not relevant to the given sentence. (आदत, अभ्‍यास, ऐसी बात जिसे हम प्रायः बिना पूर्व विचार के करें और जिसे रोकना कठिन हो) • **"Papers" **refer to documents or written materials, and are not relevant to the given sentence. (काग़ज़) • **"Mediums"** is a plural noun that refers to different materials or channels used for communication or art, but it does not fit the context of the given sentence. (कुछ व्‍यक्त या संप्रेषित करने का माध्‍यम) 3f:T8a7, The correct answer is **"are meant."**
